scope.description: Eligibility of support consumed for one public VerifyLeader future in a real leadership period, with fixed membership containing at least three voters and at least one nonvoter. Compare public completion with independently established eligibility of possible contributing peers.
assumptions: Non-Byzantine real target workers and correct in-memory transport/store behavior.
Unique validated member identities; no membership change, restart, user restore or leadership transfer during the checked interval.
The observer establishes absence of contributing remote voter replies for the selected future; inability to establish this is incomplete attribution, not a violation.
excluded: No assertion that VerifyLeader failure is necessary whenever current network reachability is low.
No requirement for eventual success, exact timing or a particular error.
No claim of stale application reads, divergent committed logs or crash durability.

parameters.success_condition: nil Error() on the correlated public future
parameters.forbidden_support: self plus only Nonvoter notifications when voter quorum is greater than one

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: Only test transport adaptation: disable optional pipeline using ErrPipelineReplicationNotSupported; apply finite outgoing request delays before actual InmemTransport.AppendEntries.
No implementation code replacement or critical protocol state assignment. FSM returns applied command bytes to establish prefix completion.
Result support is an upper bound on real positive voter contributions, not a synthetic response or inferred result from packet delivery.
Five-second observation timeout emits incomplete without a completed event; cleanup releases requests independently of the property.
boundaries: No assertion that VerifyLeader failure is necessary whenever current network reachability is low.
No requirement for eventual success, exact timing or a particular error.
No claim of stale application reads, divergent committed logs or crash durability.
The obligation is a derived authority-check support condition, not an explicit voter-quorum sentence in the API.
Actual result and attribution require trusted execution and correspondence review.
This checker cannot prove all eligible acknowledgements were consumed; it only detects success when even their upper bound is insufficient.
A timeout does not establish a liveness failure or bounded holds; the corresponding admitted operation remains incomplete.
Snapshot and pipelined support producers remain unexercised independent variants.
Same-history contribution isolation and public completion still require trusted execution.
Broader stale-read consequence requires a separate observed newer decision and application endpoint.
This variant does not exercise pipelining or fast heartbeat callbacks.
No crash-durable backend, restart, user restore or live membership change is included.
No stale application read or conflicting decision endpoint is observed.
Transport errors and leases can instead cause legitimate failure; bounded absence of completion remains incomplete.
